latest_release.name: AutoClip Desktop v1.6.1
latest_release.body:
## AutoClip Desktop v1.6.1

### 下载与安装 / Download and install

| 平台 | 文件 | 首次打开 |
|---|---|---|
| macOS 15 及以上（Apple Silicon）| `AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.1_aarch64.dmg` | 双击一次。若被拦截：系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → **仍要打开**（[Apple](https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=saqachfa)） |
| 较旧的 macOS（Apple Silicon）| 同上 | 未公证：右键应用 → **打开** |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.1_x64-setup.exe` | 未签名：SmartScreen → **更多信息 → 仍要运行** |
| CLI / MCP（Python 3.11+）| `autoclip-1.6.1-cli-mcp.zip` / `autoclip_mcp-1.6.1-py3-none-any.whl` | ZIP 内含安装与模型配置说明，需 FFmpeg |

Intel Mac 目前没有桌面安装包，请用 Docker（`DOCKER.md`）或 CLI。Linux 同样没有桌面安装包，请用 Docker、上面的 `uvx`，或 `pip install -e .` 跑 `autoclip` CLI。

两个桌面包都内置便携 Python 与静态 ffmpeg，不需要预装任何东西；Windows 安装包按用户安装，不需要管理员权限，缺 WebView2 会自动下载。
桌面包目前未购置代码签名 / Apple 公证（[#119](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/issues/119)），均由公开 GitHub Actions `Desktop Build` 构建；运行前可在附件 `build-provenance.json` 核对安装包 SHA-256（Windows：`Get-FileHash AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.1_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256`；macOS：`shasum -a 256 AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.1_aarch64.dmg`）。
不下载 ZIP 时：`uvx autoclip-mcp` 安装并启动 MCP，`npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip` 安装 skill。从源码安装仍可用（在仓库根目录 `python -m pip install --no-deps .`）。

安装后若项目列表是空的，点首页「用示例项目看看效果」。示例在安装包内，不需要 API Key。
没有字幕的视频，第一次要下载本地转写组件（约 220 MB，国内网络约 15 分钟）。装不上或太慢时，打开「设置 → 默认模型 → 语音转字幕」，改用百炼云端转写；音频会上传到云端。导入被拦住时，点「改用云端转写」。

A video without subtitles downloads the local transcription component the first time (about 220 MB, about 15 minutes on a slow network). Built-in portable Python + static ffmpeg, nothing else to install. On macOS 15 and later, double-click once; if blocked, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway ([Apple](https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=saqachfa)). Older macOS: right-click the app → Open. Windows is unsigned (SmartScreen → More info → Run anyway); code signing/notarization is tracked in [#119](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/issues/119). Every installer is built publicly on GitHub Actions (`Desktop Build`) — verify exact SHA-256 hashes against the attached `build-provenance.json` (`Get-FileHash AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.1_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256` on Windows, `shasum -a 256 AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.1_aarch64.dmg` on macOS). There is no Intel Mac desktop build; use Docker or the CLI. If a listed file is missing, that platform's build failed for this tag — see the Desktop Build workflow run.
Without the ZIP: `uvx autoclip-mcp` installs and starts MCP, and `npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip` installs the skill. Installing from a source checkout still works (`python -m pip install --no-deps .` from the repo root).

### 更新 / Changes

### 新增

- 支持签名 `v2` 云端动态服务商配置：无需发版即可热更新增、删、改、查 OpenAI 兼容服务商及其多语言信息、推荐顺序与状态通知；已保存的兼容连接在服务商下线后仍保持可用。
- 支持云端动态模板库与社区模板导入：内置滚动 `templates-catalog` 目录、支持导入/卸载 `.zip` 自定义模板包（13 语），新增 GTA VI 创作者包及 3 款游戏分屏 / 画中画模板，并优化单行模板轮播与 YuNet 主播摄像头 ROI 自动识别。
- 自定义 OpenAI 兼容连接支持 HTTP Header 键值对、`reasoning_effort` 和服务商附加 JSON 参数；模型列表、连接测试及文字/视觉调用使用同一配置，Header 值不会随公开设置返回。未配置时保持原行为。（#640 / #643）
- 服务商列表新增未保存修改提示徽章（#668），并支持 DeepSeek Flash 官方视觉模型识别（#692）。

### 修复与改进

- 修复日语假名全角字幕排版计算（#669）及 10 项社区提交的边界与稳定性问题（#678–#687）。
- 修复 9 项线上 Sentry 报错，涵盖异步下载与子进程超时容错、Windows 关停套接字异常收敛、SSE 响应断连处理、字幕与媒体边缘空值防御，以及前端设置与播放器边界异常。
- 仓库默认说明统一为英文主 README，并将 12 语说明与辅助脚本归档整理至 `docs/`、`docker/` 与 `scripts/`。

### 反馈 / Feedback
- 已知问题与当前状态：#96 · 能复现的故障走 [Issue 模板](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/issues/new/choose) · 想法与用法走 [Discussions](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/discussions)

# AutoClip ### Turn any video, link, or live stream into ready-to-post clips. **The open-source OpusClip alternative** — local-first AI clipping for **podcasts, interviews, and gaming streams** with smart reframing, captions, covers, titles, and built-in **MCP for AI agents**. Zero subscriptions, no paywall.

       


  


Website  ·  Download  ·  Live Replays (v1.6)  ·  Showcase  ·  Quick Start  ·  Docs  ·  Issues

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Português · Русский · Français · Bahasa Indonesia · Türkçe · Tiếng Việt · Deutsch


⭐ Free, MIT-licensed, zero subscriptions — everything cuts and renders on your machine. Star the repo if you find it useful!


APIMart
Low-cost AI image & video API · GPT-Image-2 from $0.006/img 		Sponsor / Partner with AutoClip
Put your AI API or creator tool in front of AutoClip users worldwide (cloud dynamic provider listing supported, zero client release needed).
christine_zhouye@163.com
--- ## Overview Drop in a link, local video, or **live stream replay** — AutoClip finds the best moments, tracks the speaker, burns in captions, generates covers, and exports ready-to-post clips for TikTok, Shorts, Reels, YouTube, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Bilibili. **Local-first by design:** cutting and rendering run directly on your computer with no upload queues and no monthly fee. Bring your own API key or run 100% offline with **Ollama / LM Studio + Whisper / SenseVoice**. ![AutoClip v1.6 Live Stream Replays Walkthrough](docs/images/v1.6/autoclip-v1.6-demo.gif)

Home → 6 Live Replay sources → OBS WebSocket setup → Twitch import → Finished clip with captions & one-click publish.

--- ## What's New in v1.6 | Feature | Details | | :--- | :--- | | **6 Live Replay Sources** | Dedicated **Live Replay** tab supporting **OBS Studio, Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Discord, and local recordings**. | | **OBS Auto-Capture** | Connect OBS WebSocket (`4455`), trim losslessly (`-c copy`), and auto-queue clips right after you end stream. | | **Game Highlights** | Generalized highlight detection supporting **8s+** standalone plays with tighter vision/OCR budgets. | | **One-Click Repurpose** | Unified playable clip cards — switch target platforms in one click without losing previous exports. | | **13 Languages** | Full desktop UI, tray menus, and docs in 13 languages (`+ zh-TW, de, id, tr, vi`) plus Arabic RTL captions. |

Source copyrights remain with their original creators. --- ## Quick Start | Use case | Recommended setup | Requirements | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Desktop app (easiest)** | Download `.dmg` / `-setup.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/releases/latest) | Apple Silicon macOS or Windows 10/11 x64 (Python & FFmpeg bundled) | | **AI agents / CLI / MCP** | `uvx autoclip-mcp` or `npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip` | Python 3.10+ (3.11 recommended) & FFmpeg | | **Self-hosted / Linux / Intel Mac** | `docker compose up -d --build` | Docker & Compose v2 | ### 1. Desktop App 1. Download the latest installer from **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/releases/latest)** (`aarch64.dmg` for Apple Silicon macOS, `x64-setup.exe` for Windows). Portable Python and FFmpeg are bundled. 2. Open **Settings**, pick a cloud provider (or start Ollama / LM Studio), test the connection, and save — or click **Try the built-in example** with no API key. 3. Paste a video link, drop a file, or switch to **Live Replay** to connect OBS or import a stream recording. Pick your platforms and click **Generate**. > Installers are built publicly on GitHub Actions (`Desktop Build`) with `build-provenance.json` SHA-256 verification. First launch on an unsigned build: on **macOS** run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/AutoClip Desktop.app"` (or *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*); on **Windows** click **More info → Run anyway** on SmartScreen. See **[Code Signing & Verification Policy](CODE_SIGNING.md)** (notarization tracked in [#119](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/issues/119)). ### 2. CLI & MCP (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode & scripts) Let AI coding agents clip videos directly from your terminal (`claude mcp add autoclip -- uvx autoclip-mcp`). Full MCP setup guides: **[English](docs/MCP.en.md)** · [简体中文](docs/CLI_AND_MCP.md) · [日本語](docs/MCP.ja.md) · [한국어](docs/MCP.ko.md) · [Español](docs/MCP.es.md) · [Deutsch](docs/MCP.de.md). ```bash uvx autoclip-mcp npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip autoclip --version autoclip produce talk.mp4 --srt talk.srt --platform tiktok --portrait-style podcast --json autoclip outputs PROJECT_ID --export-kits ```
Offline wheel, source install & MCPB packaging ```bash # Install from a downloaded CLI/MCP release ZIP wheel python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps autoclip_mcp-*-py3-none-any.whl # Or install from source python -m pip install --no-deps . ``` To build a local MCPB bundle without publishing, run `python scripts/pack_mcpb.py` (never run `smithery mcp publish` automatically).
### 3. Docker / Web ```bash git clone https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip.git cd autoclip cp env.example .env mkdir -p data logs uploads docker compose up -d --build ``` Open the web UI at `http://localhost:3000` (API docs at `http://localhost:8000/docs`). See [Docker Guide](docs/DOCKER.en.md) for bind-mount permissions and custom origins. --- ## Benchmarks Measured on an Apple Silicon Mac (LLM cost estimated with `qwen-plus`; excludes cloud ASR and AI image generation; check your provider bill for exact usage): | Input | Source | Time & Output | Est. LLM Cost | | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | | **With existing subtitles** | Jensen Huang · 1h 43m (EN → Xiaohongshu) | **7.5 min / 10 clips** | **¥0.09** | | **No subtitles (local Whisper)** | TIM × Luo Yonghao · 2h 52m (ZH → Douyin) | 29.5 min / 10 clips | ¥0.20 | --- ## Sponsor ❤️

APIMart 		Thanks to APIMart for sponsoring AutoClip! APIMart is a low-cost API platform for AI image & video generation — GPT-Image-2 from $0.006/image (160+ images per dollar). One async API covers both image and video: submit a task, get an ID, fetch results via polling or callback. Batch tens of thousands of images without timeouts and switch models without changing code. Pay-as-you-go with no monthly fee — sign up here.
## Cloud Transcription (Alibaba Cloud) *Affiliate link (separate from the sponsor above):* sign up on Alibaba Cloud, create an API key in the Bailian console, and enable Bailian cloud ASR under **Settings → Default models → Speech to subtitles**. 1. [Alibaba Cloud signup](https://www.aliyun.com/benefit?userCode=qmyj6jch) (affiliate link) 2. [Bailian console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/) — create your API key --- ## FAQ
Is AutoClip free? Do I need an API key? Yes — AutoClip is free and MIT-licensed. Cloud analysis, transcription, and AI covers use your own API keys at provider rates (local cover layout is free by default). Ollama and LM Studio require no cloud key. Direct publishing uses your own Bilibili or [Upload-Post](https://www.upload-post.com) account.
Does my video get uploaded to the cloud? Cutting and rendering run locally. Cloud analysis only sends transcript text; vision models only receive sampled frames; cloud ASR uploads audio. Running local LLMs + Whisper / SenseVoice keeps everything offline. Analytics and crash reports can be turned off in Settings. See [Privacy](docs/PRIVACY.en.md).
What kind of videos work best? Podcasts, interviews, talks, courses, and gaming live stream replays (OBS / Twitch / YouTube / Kick / Discord). Sources with existing subtitles are fastest; otherwise use local Whisper / SenseVoice or cloud ASR. For gameplay or low-dialogue streams, enable a vision-capable model.
Why weren't any clips generated? Check the failed stage: subtitles/transcription, model connection, FFmpeg, disk space, or platform length limits (YouTube long-form requires ≥180s; use Shorts, TikTok, or Bilibili for shorter clips). If it still fails, open an issue with `autoclip --version`, OS, model, and redacted logs, or check [Known Issues (#96)](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/issues/96).

If AutoClip saves you time, a ⭐ star helps! - **Community:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/discussions) · [First-Clip Q&A](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/discussions/128) · [Feature Ideas](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/discussions/129) - **Bug reports:** use the [issue template](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/issues/new/choose) with OS, version, model, repro steps, and redacted logs - **Partnerships:** [christine_zhouye@163.com](mailto:christine_zhouye@163.com) AutoClip is maintained solo — please expect async replies (no live or 1-on-1 setup support). ![Star History](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=zhouxiaoka/autoclip&type=Date) Built with FastAPI, React, Tauri, FFmpeg, yt-dlp, Whisper, and FunASR.
